intro: Kenya is a presidential republic with power shared between national and county governments.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years, up to two terms; William Ruto took office in 2022. Parliament has a National Assembly and a Senate. 47 counties have their own governors.

chapters.title: Courts
text: In 2017 the Supreme Court cancelled a presidential election result, a first in Africa.
